description: Adds an HTTP or SOCKS proxy. Monitors use it once their proxyId is set to its ID (createMonitor / updateMonitor), or all at once with applyExisting. Pass username and password for a proxy that needs them.

applyExisting.description: Also route every existing monitor through this proxy now. One-off: it is not stored.

default.description: Make it the proxy the web UI preselects for new monitors; the previous default stops being one

host.description: Proxy host name or IP address

includeSecrets.description: Return credentials in full instead of "***"; they then stay in the transcript. Default: false, or UPTIME_KUMA_INCLUDE_SECRETS.

password.description: For a proxy that needs a login. A credential.

protocol.description: Proxy protocol: http, https, socks, socks5, socks5h, socks4

username.description: For a proxy that needs a login

name: createProxy

auth.description: Whether the proxy takes a username and password

default.description: New monitors created in the web UI use this proxy

password.description: A credential: "***" unless includeSecrets is set

protocol.description: One of http, https, socks, socks5, socks5h, socks4

title: Create Proxy
